# ghost/dart-checker

Dart Checker (F-Droid): start an X01 game, enter each dart (single, double, triple, bull, miss), end turns and read the remaining scores. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/dart-checker
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker throw --device <serial> --param dart=<dart>
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker throw_darts --device <serial> --param darts=<darts>
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker end_turn --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker undo --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dart-checker get_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a 301 darts game with one player
- `throw`: Score a triple twenty in the darts game
- `throw_darts`: Enter the darts treble twenty, twenty and miss
- `end_turn`: End my turn in the darts game
- `undo`: Undo the last dart
- `get_state`: What is the darts score?
